avr8js 0.21.1 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2019-2025 Uri Shaked), from the npm package
avr8js-0.21.1.tgz, directory dist/esm.

Kept: index.js, types.js, cpu/*.js, peripherals/*.js (the runtime).
Left out: the .d.ts type files and utils/ (the assembler and test helpers).

One change: every relative import specifier gained a ".js" extension
(for example from './cpu/cpu' became from './cpu/cpu.js'), so browsers and
node load the files as ES modules without a bundler. No code was changed.

The npm package.json (which points at the CommonJS build, not copied) was
replaced by a short one with "type": "module".

Used by stella-nova/pages/breadboard-lab/mcu/avr.js (the HEX runner).
